programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. programme.title: Boyette: Not A Girl Yet
programme.desc: A college freshman pretends to be straight in order to get closer to his crush who is homophobe.

programme.title: Maybe This Time
programme.desc: \"Steph Asuncion and Tonio Bugayong were once in love. Back then, she was a young girl who wanted a simple life and he was older, more ambitious than she was. Tonio was a small town guy who wants to board a ship to provide for his family’s furniture business. Sarah was a Manila girl who spends the summer in the province for community service. What might have been a sweet relationship ended sourly when Tonio left without saying goodbye. Steph was heartbroken and it taught her to dream bigger to be worthy of love. Will their paths cross again? Will they overcome the pains of the past to give love a second chance? This is a story between two people who will be reminded about the importance of being true to one’s self in order for true love to happen.\".

programme.title: Exes Baggage
programme.desc: After a chance encounter, Pia and Nix instantly hit it off. Natural conversations eventually develop into deep attraction. Despite their wounds from previous relationships, both decide to take a chance on each other. But when their love blossoms into a relationship, their differences will test their love and will make them question: Are they ready for love when they're still carrying baggage from their past?

programme.title: Food Network HD
programme.desc: Food Network is a unique lifestyle network that connects viewers to the power and joy of food. It is a trusted resource that strives to teach, inspire, empower and entertain viewers through engaging content hosted by authentic personalities, world-class chefs and culinary experts. Available in more than 10 countries in Asia Pacific, the network offers a mix of local original productions and global programming featuring kitchen competition, culinary adventure, instructional cooking and home entertaining. Food Network is part of Scripps Networks Interactive, one of the world’s leading producers of lifestyle content. More information available on www.foodnetworkasia.com or Facebook page www.facebook.com/foodnetworkasia.
